reviewNotes: Twenty-five weapon-stat, animal-tool, slingshot, equipment-name, and blacksmith strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, established combat and tool terminology, gender-neutral animal feedback, command wording, dynamic tool labels, punctuation, and character voice; both found no remaining objective issue.
